horoscopes.horoscope: Today will be as agreeable as any day can be. You are satisfied with what you have, says Ganesha. Besides, you have already planned on what you desire and are moving towards it. A date of romantic nature may turn out to be interesting or it may lead to a controversy; you have to decide on it. Your loved one is eagerly waiting for you. You might feel happier and safer in the lap of your sweetheart. Your childish attitude is likely to win some hugs and kisses from your partner. Rejoice, chill out and enjoy the best of the evening. You will have good energy today. You may need this energy in taking initiatives about pending communications. You may as well use this energy by remaining in touch with people. You will feel energetic even if the day is long and tiring. You will not be satisfied with mere financial stability and security as you want more than that. However, you will also reconcile yourself as you will realise that every day cannot be the same. Commonsense will give you a miss today, so you’d be tearing your hair, trying to wade through the fog in your brain to handle important issues. Calm down, says Ganesha, and organize your thoughts. Despite the confusion, you’d still find yourself doing some R&D to add to your knowledge bank.

This day is meant for taking some time out from your busy schedule, and seeking some fun and relaxation. So says Ganesha. It is possible that you will be getting together with your friends and family members for a fun filled evening followed by a great dinner and a late night movie. The strong urge to eat hot, spicy and delicious dishes is surely going to get the better of you. So go ahead and have fun. Your sweet, giving nature will brighten up your beloved, who will thank you in ways more amazing than you can imagine! You tend to be sensual and give your sweetheart the maximum pleasure he/she needs. Understanding your loved one will boost your relationship. You won’t have health problems today. So, you will be able to give better output. However, too much verbal communication with others may make you feel tired. You should try to avoid speaking much and must not talk about unnecessary things. You should make the most of the financial opportunities coming your way but selection of the right opportunity is more important than anything else. You are also likely to be anxious about money matters. You’d be juggling many important projects today. You will depend on technological means to speed up output. Keyboard shortcuts or the best social media practices will help you grab the best position. You tend to be decisive and apply the best techniques that results in positive outputs.

You know where you are headed, and will redouble your efforts to reach your goals today. You are full of energy and enthusiasm, which helps you to achieve all your targets. You will receive unexpected gains owing to your hard work. Bountiful success will be yours at the end of a hard day’s labour, says Ganesha. Your expert moves will whip up unbridled passion in your loved one. The evening will see you enjoying a candlelit dinner with your partner. You might read out some wonderful quotes from a romantic novel. Ganesha feels that it’s a good time to propose your sweetheart. This day begins on a positive note. You shall wake up with fresh ideas and put them into practice today. The outcome of your work will surprisingly exceed the expectations of your superiors. In return, you can expect handsome rewards More you connect with people, richer you will become, points out Ganesha. This is ideal time to make your writings or speech – the source of earning. Try to be more communicative, open and frank. Your get-up-and-go attitude will see you juggle more than one task today. Multitasking might not be a worthy experience today. Completion of a particular set of action would be difficult. After studying today’s planetary configuration, Ganesha advises you do some research before undertaking a project.

A restless or irritating mood is indicated. Keep you cool and be calm even in adverse circumstances, suggests Ganesha. If you do so, you will always succeed in life. It is difficult to wriggle out of adversity, if you have hot temper. Josh Groban’s “You raise me up” is the best medicine to cheer you up, suggests Ganesha. At the end of the day, you will get at least someone special who will cure your pains. The whole-hearted support from your lover will melt away your worries and relax your mood. Today you shall prefer to compromise with adamant people and tough times. This change in your attitude will be due to the fact that sometimes it is better to forgive and let go in order to gain peace of mind. There is likely to be a big hole in your pocket today, foresees Ganesha. There are more chances of spending money and less chances of earning a good sum. The shopping bug will get you today. Today, the day is not too favorable in the office. Tempers may flare, resulting in a war of words between you and your colleagues. All this may be due to frustration resulting from the time and energy wasted doing mammoth projects. Take a break and ignite your sense of humor, suggests Ganesha.

You will be able to influence people with your co-operative and accomodating attitude today. You will have discussions on various topics with people who come into contact with you. You will also come into contact with people who share the same mental wavelength as you do, says Ganesha. Today you are in a fresh and spirited outlook. Your outlook will be admired by your sweetheart. You will plan something crazy and big to reward your loved one. It will be a wonderful night to be in the arm of your lover, feels Ganesha. You shall feel very fit and fine on this fantastic day. A strenuous workout and healthy breakfast will enable your mind and body to work swiftly and tirelessly. You shall be very efficient and also guide coworkers to finish their tasks. Even if you wish to take personal loan from a friend, be frank and open enough to show your cards and take loan on friendly grounds. You do have stars in your favour for the income. You may encounter some complex problems at work today. Never retreat, never give up, inspires Ganesha. God almighty is testing your patience and concentration level, feels Ganesha. You might overcome this challenging situation.

Ganesha says don’t let setbacks cow you down today as you will emerge stronger from each one of them. It will be your logic and reasoning abilities that will aid you in gaining the perfection in completing your work. You may look forward to spending the evening with your beloved or a special friend. You will be engrossed in an animated conversation. As there are chances that you may have a brush with conflicts, Ganesha wants you to choose your words carefully, even with your loved one. Avoid neglecting your sweetheart. Remember taking proper care of your partner is the keys to strengthening the relationship. Your ambition and determination shall zoom today. You will work arduously to complete all the pending tasks in your workplace and home. But, take care and don’t overstrain yourself, else it may take a long time to regain peak fitness. Ganesha feels that today you will have to maintain very good rapport with your friends, colleagues, business associates and bosses. Everyone with whom you are related via your work – can benefit you in a big way. Your motto for the day is, “Work is worship”. The only thoughts that will occupy you is career and matters related to your profession. You are crazy for professional success. Maintaining the standard and ethics are your forte now. However, Ganesha wants you to focus on all issues equally.

Ganesha says that today you will get worried over petty matters and be tense. To get mental peace keep yourself occupied with religious or spiritual activity. Along with that if you go to some religious place you will gain mental peace, which will stay with you for a long time. You will be on cloud nine tonight. You will be ready to do whatever your lover demands and if he or she is indifferent, you would like to please by taking proper care. A wonderful evening with your darling will complete a rather satisfying day. Today you are likely to feel very lazy. Thus you shall give some excuse for not attending your office and put work on the back burner. Naturally, your love/life partner will be happy, because you shall spend more time with him/her. Today you will be depending on your luck and on others for your financial progress, predicts Ganesha. Your own efforts will have less contribution to your financial opportunities or gains today. Have you been awaiting a raise. The day is finally here when you can negotiate your remuneration. Now you will feel you are not in the danger zone as far as your job is concerned, your productivity will increase manifold, assures Ganesha.

According to Ganesha, you will be soaked in your work today. During the day, you may be loaded with duties and responsibilities, however, evening has a different story to reveal. Exciting as ever, a get away with friends may be liberating and relaxing. You might be eager to take your current relationship to the next level. Your intimate and passionate times with your loved one will bring the wedding bells closer to you. Your commitment to your sweetheart is the key to keep the relationship going. The stars suggest that your health may be a cause of concern on this boring day. If required, visit your doctor and take sufficient rest. Eat well, sleep well and think well. Adopt a positive approach and a healthy lifestyle. Think more positively about money and see light at the end of the tunnel. This is the best way to attract more coins towards you. The day does not favour any investments so don’t try to start something new. Be prepared for the bad time in the office today. Avoid delays in pending works at any cost. Else you would be in great trouble, warns Ganesha. Dedication, commitment and patience are some criteria to achieve positive results, suggests Ganesha.

A day to full of caution, warns Ganesha. There are chances that your heart will find its partner, forcing you to fall in love. You may be cupid’s next prey. However, watch your steps, as the initial stages of a relationship may be fragile and need to handled with care. Also, it’s time to guard your reputation. Your natural spirit might get affected somewhere and you might feel clueless. You will feel great if you are ready to listen to your sweetheart. Your flexibility will hold the key to bliss. Get ready to get plenty of kisses and sweet hugs to strengthen the relationship. Today your heart is likely to rule over your mind. You may easily get upset if someone criticizes you. Your confidence level may dip, and your mood may swing downwards. Try to overcome negative thoughts by practicing yoga and meditation. Ganesha feels that attempt to save is not going to help. Just spend and make others feel happy. You ought to consider yourself lucky with regard to financial matters today. Listen, if you plan to work on technical projects, then it’s better you shift it to some other day as today, your energy levels aren’t high enough to match the work pressure in the office. Your desktop will get piled up with too many tasks that you will feel difficult to achieve.

It has become difficult for you to bear the heavy weight of responsibilities on your shoulders. But, be prepared for some more; the weight is about to get heavier as more responsibilities are going to be added. You will no longer enjoy the work, and it will bring down your efficiency level to an extent, feels Ganesha. Also, your kind hearted nature will come to the fore as you will lend a helping hand to those in need. Be cautious in your personal life as well, warns Ganesha. Both of you must celebrate your differences. Don’t let them create a distance between you and your soul mate. If your sweetheart is not ready to communicate, bringing him or her closer to you is your responsibility, suggests Ganesha. Your motto for the day will be health is wealth. You shall become very conscious about your well-being as working long hours has recently affected your health. Review and revise your daily schedule. Be positive and don’t worry – enjoy life. This could be worst day for speculation and any investments in the stock market so don’t even think of buying new stocks. Ganesha feels that today you should just focus on your day to day routine. Current planetary alignment shows that you are in for some trouble. Either you are not in the much-needed speed or facing setbacks in implementing the best projects. Ganesha warns you against lowering your guards as your colleagues are eager to renew old rivalries.

You are talented, hard working, confident and down to earth. These four characteristics are the pillars of success. Now, it is time build the building. Your curiosity and desire to achieve your goals will help you with it, feels Ganesha. In order to succeed, you may skip a ‘quality check’ of your output. You may be ready to experiment something different with your loved one. Keep a tab on your foul mood when you meet your sweetheart. Give in to his or her silly demands for the sake of love and smile away your blues, advises Ganesha. Your heart will rule over your head. You shall do things, that you always wanted to do, but could not do, for some reason or another. Dine at your favourite restaurant with loved ones, but don’t overeat to avoid indigestion. If your heart says that this is right investment, just don’t think twice. The day is also very favourable for selling out property that you own or selling an old vehicle or any other electronic item. Since you’ll be suffering constant mood swings today, your concerted effort at meeting deadlines will go unnoticed. Instead, your superior will demand that you handle more tasks than one. Doing yoga or meditation will help you focus with ease, feels Ganesha.

A reckless attitude is the root cause of any downfall. Ensure responsible behavior and actions at every step at your workplace, today, suggests Ganesha. Be alert and focused and you will be able to dodge any incoming trouble. Today is a day of materialization and the projects and other things that you have been working on since a long time will draw close to completion and begin to pay off. Today you are passionate and energetic. Your desire to meet your loved one will be so strong you may overstep the speed limit. A splendid time with your sweetheart in a movie theater is on the cards, says Ganesha. Plan first, propose later, suggests Ganesha. You may experience mood swings throughout this dull day. Your heart shall move in one direction, and your head may try to go in the opposite direction. Hence, you are likely to take mindless decisions and go off-track. This is ideal day to do research on house or vehicle to buy but final decision can be taken at a later stage. Ganesha feels that the day is good for surfing and speculating but not for buying. Today’s celestial energies make you enterprising enough to accomplish your tasks without experiencing any problems. You will be in a mood to inject new life at your workplace. You’ll feel satisfied after working out your priorities and putting an action plan in place.
